method: Independent model lexical review of all 56 cases, reading exact source synonym senses and every supplied same-POS target sense in two manageable batches. Selected one reliable useful English sense per approved case, or an explicit inline English gloss with null target fields. Source membership alone is not approval; POS mismatches, absent target evidence and uncertain lexical alignments are withheld. Target sense indices are zero-based within the exact hash-bound target row. Source and target usage labels are retained separately; target gender does not replace the source spelling's gender. Original concise selected renderings are source-grounded, not fabricated examples or native-human certification. Verbs are dictionary infinitives only, not authorization of finite rendering; all aspectModes are empty. No answer-eligibility, application source, save or pool changes; no publication.
